verdicts.reason: Both pull the headline out of the white heart. The heart becomes an empty outline floating in the middle of a white field, and the photo is a small boxed inset instead of a full bleed. A at least keeps the headline and URL together in a clean centred column on the right. In B the headline sits jammed under the heart's bottom points and close to the bottom edge, and the URL floats to its right at an arbitrary height, which breaks grouping and alignment.
